title: Address AI equity and subgroup performance
requirements:
- Require representative data and subgroup performance reporting (age, sex, disability, language, setting)
- Extend equity assessment across the lifecycle (deployment, access, language, workflow, consequences of error)
- Require evaluation of record-linkage accuracy and differential harms before linked data is used for AI
- Require evaluation against locally representative populations and languages, with subgroup evaluation and response to disparities
- Note the compounded risk where independent verification capacity is limited
